notes.title: Update!!!!!!!
notes.content:
Added a weather system.
Updated the interface, more visual stuff.
Fixed a bunch of bugs.
I redesigned the packaging of the game, which reduced the weight from 30 to 4 GB. But this is before the release of the game, there will be all 30GB. But while the beta is on, enjoy.
Did something else.
Made the landscape work normally.
I'm still hitting the lighting in the face so that it works as it should.{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40959765/710442dddee2ed603686c5b4ebaf9d52f7d1a485.png

notes.title: METRO MP v2.0
notes.content:
Changes
The save system now works via SQLite.

Additions
Added several types of weapons, now there are 8 types. Screenshots will be in the update.
Added admin panel. You can configure its buttons and categories in RemoteAdmin.json

Fixes
Fixed some bugs with item synchronization.

Forward to the future
Finally a miracle happened and I started working on the main menu ːzoteː. The menu is 46% ready.
Started moving the game to UE version 4.27
